ledger: The AI Receipts — a public AI data-center buildout ledger
public_source_note: This file is the public source of record for https://aidc.datacap.xyz. Every fact rendered on the page traces back to an entry here. Coverage is curated, not exhaustive — see 'methodology' below.
methodology: Every event is dated and sourced. Dates use the most precise resolution the source supports (YYYY-MM-DD > YYYY-MM > YYYY). 'undisclosed' is a first-class value, not a gap. Confidence: HIGH = confirmed date + independently reviewable source; MEDIUM = named source, date approximate; LOW = single source, unverified. Source types: company-claim | news | permit | filing | epoch-satellite | undisclosed. GPU install counts are not publicly observable at most sites and are not claimed unless a named source discloses them. This ledger tracks a curated working set of publicly reported sites selected for verifiable, linkable sourcing — it is not a complete census of the industry. Entries are reviewed before publication; claims that cannot be independently corroborated are not included.
